question: Where’s the closest museum lying along the route toward ClipArt Gallery, East Boston, MA from Blue Ocean Discovery Center, Hampton, NH?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.810543 42.909869)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-71.042225 42.367672)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.810543 42.909869)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.810543 42.909869)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Essex Historical Society and Shipbuilding Museum

[2].display_name: Blue Ocean Discovery Center, Hampton, NH
